objective: Triage refuses a false positive with no justification
preconditions: a confirmed finding from the live scan
input: a false positive with no justification
expected: It throws. A suppression with no reason behind it is somebody switching the check off, and a workflow that accepts it quietly is how a gate becomes decoration
detail: Refusing to mark BOLA as FalsePositive with no justification. A suppression with no stated reason is indistinguishable from turning the check off, and the gate counts it as open either way.
